notes.title: Demo update - free district - The Cathedral
notes.content:
The city of Türme is in trouble! Ooze is rising all across the city, but the bell's call forces all evil beneath the earth

This week the demo gets the next district!

The Cathedral district wraps up the first phase of your resurrection in Ichorous Moon:

- Ring the Cathedral bell to save the district, but at a heavy cost...
- Explore the stories of the local denizens

Check it out and let me know what you think. via the community hub or socials :D

Keep an eye on YouTube for the dev diary updates, like this shmick release trailer:
[previewyoutube=sE8wKHnwOto;full][/previewyoutube]

This update wraps up the demo content for now... I'm off to architect the remaining towers in detail before the full release!

notes.title: Demo update - RPG elements unlocked - Vendors and Allies
notes.content:
The city of Türme is in trouble! Ooze is rising all across the city, you'll have to get stronger to save it but don't worry, you've got help!

This week the demo gets a short update on the way to the next district release!

Vendors and Allies unlocks the RPG elements of Ichorous Moon:

- Upgrade your Humors; donate ooze you've collected to (de)refine your inner balance!
- Loot and craft: bring materials and blueprints to the item vendor for (useful?) gear!

Find the vendors in the Teifbahn and allies throughout the game


Check it out and let me know what you think. via the community hub or socials.

Keep an eye on YouTube for the dev diary updates, like this fancy teaser trailer:
[previewyoutube=v3yRWqSyxe8;full][/previewyoutube]


The Cathedral District is nearly ready; it will be the last update for the demo unfortunately. If there's enough interest there will be a playtest available for additional content before the release, so stay in touch!

notes.title: Demo update - free district added - The Parish
notes.content:
The city of Türme is in trouble! Ooze is rising all across the city, and it's vaguely sentient!

Something massive stalks the streets of the parish; where faith has waned and discontent waxed strong.
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869313/512782fc8c460df35ade1110faadc85c6f3f447d.png[/img]

Can you find your way to the local church and save those who remain?!
[img]{STEAM_CLAN_IMAGE}/44869313/94a61c03a871d3c184e2270d3f0079cc7fae1a57.png[/img]

This week the demo gets a hefty update! The Parish District has reached release state, explore where the working class called home; at least until the moon rose!

Check it out and let me know what you think. via the community hub or socials.

There's a new video on the !g Youtube channel showing my run through the district, if you need hints; or see if you can beat the time!

[previewyoutube=37YVo0ihrEk;full][/previewyoutube]

Next up will be the Cathedral District; which should bring the Church faction to a close... look for it soon!
